    "start_date": DAG_START_DATE,
    "schedule": DAG_SCHEDULE,
    "max_active_runs": 1,
    "max_active_tasks": 1,
    "catchup": False,
    "tags": ["dbt_analytics", "kubernetes_pod_operator", "private_data"],
}

DBT_PROJECT = "marketing"
DBT_TARGET = "private"
TABLE_NAME = "cdp_user_profile_data"

    dbt_run = DbtOperator(
        task_id=TABLE_NAME,
        dbt_command=f"dbt run --select {TABLE_NAME}",
        project=DBT_PROJECT,
        target=DBT_TARGET,
        slack_channels=DAG_CONFIG["default_args"]["params"].get("slack_channel"),
        execution_timeout=timedelta(hours=2),
    )

# table mapping for destination database is snowflake
GenericTableMapping(
    destination_schema=WAREHOUSE_SCHEMA_NAME,
    destination_table=TABLE_NAME,
    dag=dag,
    task_id=TABLE_NAME,
